title: Upper Savannah — proposed milestone evidence

source.title: DD6B proposal and production start package

scope_note: These criteria organize the existing proposed workshare. Saved evidence, engineering dispositions and reviewer readiness do not accept commercial terms, authorize an invoice or record payment. Tim / Ecosystem Sciences retains scientific direction; Bryce retains the relationship.

criteria.title: Original source inventory
criteria.detail: Retain the selected original files, sidecars, publisher/source editions and actual acquisition state. Incomplete or failed acquisition stays visible.

criteria.title: Grid and alignment
criteria.detail: Inspect the actual prepared 30 m grid: metric CRS, affine origin, dimensions, extent, NoData and coverage. Trace at least one transformation to its original source.

criteria.title: Geographic support
criteria.detail: Keep upstream contributing model domain, South Carolina reporting mask, utility focus catchments and exterior buffer distinct, with their original selections.

criteria.title: Editable scientific profile
criteria.detail: Retain the selected profile and table with coefficient lineage, algorithm settings, physical quantity meanings and missing-data assumptions for scientific review.

criteria.title: Two explicit alternatives
criteria.detail: Retain the two proposed scenario definitions, geographic masks/class transitions and purpose for ES scientific selection. Commissioning examples are identified as such.

criteria.title: Recipient source operation
criteria.detail: Open the actual retained setup project and its sources, inspect alignment/coverage and record the selected host/application/project identity. Record source/profile/scenario decisions and remaining exceptions.

criteria.title: Baseline and selected alternatives
criteria.detail: Retain the completed current-condition baseline and two reviewed alternatives with exact original run/profile/scenario selections. Partial runs remain identified.

criteria.title: Native model provenance
criteria.detail: Retain original NDR/SDR arguments, logs, physical rasters and quantitative comparisons. Source assumptions and model interpretation remain inspectable.

criteria.title: Physical units and support
criteria.detail: Inspect annual nitrogen/phosphorus kg/year and sediment delivered to streams tonnes/year on declared support. Keep erosion quantities and dimensionless priority indices distinct; check comparison signs.

criteria.title: Seven map families
criteria.detail: Inspect the seven requested map families and nine principal PDFs under the proposed two-alternative scope, plus complete GIS, metadata and report draft.

criteria.title: Traceable editable release
criteria.detail: Open saved scenarios/run outputs, trace selected findings to original maps/rasters/tables/sources and retain editable GIS/report source, operator and review material.

criteria.title: Consolidated correction lineage
criteria.detail: Retain original comments, decisions, engineering dispositions and earlier editions for the included consolidated correction. Source/profile revisions and any repeated baseline-plus-two-alternative cycle retain their actual identities.

criteria.title: Complete native project
criteria.detail: Retain complete source/data/software/native Project archive, runtime instructions and editable GIS/report source, with exact member inventory.

criteria.title: Final human-facing outputs
criteria.detail: Open and inspect the exact final maps, report, presentation and guide, preserving scientific units, support and source references.

criteria.title: Independent recipient operation
criteria.detail: Open the delivered application against an independently received Project. Inspect originals/profile/scenarios/runs, repeat an agreed export or saved comparison, and retain the exact output inventory and returned findings.
